name: גִּרְגָּשִׁי
summary: The Girgashites, one of the peoples counted among Canaan’s descendants and among the seven nations of the land. The text gives no derivation of the name.

evidence.note: The definite singular names the Girgashites alongside the Jebusites and Amorites in Canaan’s genealogy.
The Girgashites appear in a list explicitly counted as seven nations.

note: Moved from the former word entry `ggireggaaxiy` (old root key גרגשי, the noun’s own consonants).
